objective: Introduce a versioned typed confirmed-requirement contract between clarification and governed retrieval so deterministic software can validate downstream Report Design coverage without parsing arbitrary free text.
requirements: APBRA-143 Typed Confirmed Requirement Contract and Deterministic Coverage Obligations
FR-003 retain original input separately from interpretations
FR-005 capture structured material report requirements
FR-009 retain clarification questions and answers as evidence
FR-030 create a machine-readable BI design input contract
FR-035 generation consumes validated structured inputs
FR-055 the generator model is not sole validation authority
RULE-001 preserve original input as immutable evidence
RULE-007 missing business definitions cannot be fabricated
adrs: AI is advisory; deterministic software owns validation and release policy
acceptance_criteria: A schema-versioned immutable ConfirmedRequirementContract is deterministically materialized after explicit clarification selection and before governed retrieval or Report Design generation.

Original requirement, schema identity, AI interpretation, questions, displayed answers or selections, confirmation and source versions remain separate immutable provenance rather than downstream semantic authority.

Every material blocking clarification offers stable typed options whose effects reference only declared schema fields, obligation IDs and supported semantic types; exactly one selected option is required unless the clarification explicitly supports a bounded multi-select.
Free text may be retained as provenance but cannot create or alter measure, filter, lifecycle, trend, page, field, business-question or presentation obligations through downstream parsing.
Required measures and KPIs have stable IDs and supported structured semantics including aggregation and source field or operands, typed filter predicates, context field and format where applicable.

The contract represents exact Table.Column fields and dimensions, filters, lifecycle or status membership, time field and supported grain, required pages, business-question mappings, and required versus optional presentation obligations with minimum representation cardinality where applicable.

The contract validator rejects duplicate or unresolved IDs, unknown schema fields or options, missing required selections, unsupported aggregation, predicate or time-grain semantics, contradictory obligations and incomplete provenance before retrieval begins.

Deterministic coverage consumes only the validated confirmed contract and Report Design structure and proves required KPI, filter, trend, lifecycle, page, dimension or field, business-question and minimum-presentation obligations.
Optional or redundant presentations may be removed only when all required obligations remain covered; visual titles and the repair model are never semantic authority.
Original and repaired Report Designs remain distinct evidence and every changed candidate is revalidated by APBRA-138, APBRA-139, APBRA-141 and APBRA-142 controls.
Production behavior remains scenario-neutral and contains no ServiceNow, report, filename, field, KPI, page or prompt-string special case.
The retained APBRA-142 failed live run remains immutable evidence and is not overwritten.
verification_required: Focused typed-clarification and confirmed-contract positive and negative tests
Deterministic coverage tests for KPI, filter, trend, lifecycle, page, dimension, field, business-question and presentation cardinality obligations
Existing APBRA-138, APBRA-139, APBRA-141 and APBRA-142 regressions
Full web test suite and production build
Hosted history-aware secret scan and fresh exact-head independent AI review
Current-head approved synthetic GPT-4.1 happy path through deterministic candidate validation after implementation
Haseeb Power BI Desktop validation of any newly generated candidate
out_of_scope: Downstream heuristic or arbitrary-language parsing of clarification free text
Allowing the interpretation, design or repair model to validate its own semantic preservation
PBIP compiler, guardrail, RAG algorithm or corpus, schema-ingestion, PDF, styling, dependency, backend, infrastructure, environment or security-model changes
Weakening APBRA-138 measure integrity, APBRA-139 normalization, APBRA-141 pipeline ordering, APBRA-142 coverage or one-attempt geometry controls
Scenario-specific ServiceNow, report-name, filename, field, KPI, page or prompt-string logic
Production deployment, automatic merge or claiming Power BI Desktop success without Haseeb confirmation
escalate_when: A required path is outside the exact eight-file allowlist
A material clarification answer cannot be expressed using the supported typed option and obligation vocabulary
Accepted sources conflict or an APBRA-138, APBRA-139, APBRA-141 or APBRA-142 invariant would need weakening
Implementation would require heuristic interpretation of arbitrary answer text or visual titles
Live Foundry, build, bootstrap, hosted secret scanning or fresh independent review is unavailable
